content.text:
I removed the Friday restriction from `src/solution.py`. I didn't run the code or write any checks.

Specifically, I deleted the `FRIDAY_LAST_START_HOUR` constant, the `friday_cutoff` variable and the check that skipped Friday starts after 15:00. Friday now follows the same rules as every other day.

Everything else is as it was. That includes the function signature, the `day` parameter, the conversion of ISO dates to weekday names, working hours of 09:00–17:00, the lunch exclusion, the 15-minute start times and the event-conflict logic.
